businesses.business: household consumer products (foil, bags, disposable tableware)

offering_description.value: Makes and sells branded and store-brand household consumer products such as aluminum foil, trash and food storage bags, and disposable cookware and tableware. Sells mainly to grocery, mass, club, dollar and online retailers, which resell to consumers. Manufactures in its own plants from purchased aluminum and resin.

primary_products.value: aluminum foil; trash bags; food storage bags; disposable cookware and baking items; disposable plates, cups and cutlery

customer_segment.value: B2B: Grocery, mass merchandise, club, dollar and e-commerce retailers, plus foodservice customers

end_markets.value: household consumer goods; grocery retail; foodservice

revenue_model.value: product sales: Branded and store-brand household products sold to retailers

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: Converts purchased aluminum and plastic resin into finished consumer products sold to retailers; brand owner: Owns household brands and also makes private-label products for retailers

geography_served.value: North America: Mainly United States, with Canada

specialization.value: related lines: Foil, waste and storage bags, and disposable tableware and cookware sold to the same retail customers

distribution_channels.value: third-party retail: Grocery, mass, club and dollar stores selling to consumers; online: E-commerce retailers and marketplaces; direct sales: Sales to foodservice and large retail accounts

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Food-contact materials rules (FDA), product labeling, environmental and plastic bag regulations, and trade tariffs
